parsed.summary: The patch resolves the issue by allowing subclasses of BigAutoField and SmallAutoField in the _subclasses property. It introduces new test files to reproduce and verify the fix.

issues.description: The patch introduces new files (example/core/__init__.py, example/core/models.py, reproduce.py, test_edge_cases.py) which are not strictly necessary for fixing the issue.
The patch does not follow the project's convention for naming test files. It uses 'reproduce.py' and 'test_edge_cases.py' instead of the conventional 'test_*.py'.
